news.title: Man injured in northwest Atlanta shooting overnight, police recover shell casings
news.summary: A 24-year-old man is recovering after a shooting in northwest Atlanta early Saturday, according to Atlanta Police. An investigation is underway.

news.title: MDMA, marijuana, and guns found during Athens traffic stop
news.summary: A traffic stop in downtown Athens led to the arrest of two men after officers found drugs and firearms inside a vehicle, according to police.

news.title: Police investigating shooting in Washington Park area of Atlanta
news.summary: Police are investigating after a person was shot Saturday morning in the Washington Park neighborhood of northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Pair admits role in gang-related hit that left man dead in Gwinnett
news.summary: Two men from out-of-state have pleaded guilty to their roles in a gang-related shooting in Gwinnett County that left one man dead and another seriously injured, prosecutors said.

news.title: Five arrested after fight at East Coweta football game; firearm found
news.summary: A halftime fight at the East Coweta/Newnan football game led to five arrests, says the Coweta County School System, as deputies recovered an unshot firearm.

news.title: Car hauler leaves I-75, crashes into trees
news.summary: A driver was seriously injured after a crash involving a vehicle hauling a car trailer along Interstate 75 in Cobb County early Saturday morning, according to police.

news.title: Man shot in Chamblee shopping plaza
news.summary: The Chamblee Police Department is investigating a shooting that left a man injured early Saturday morning.

news.title: 5 in custody after fight, gun found at high school football game
news.summary: The fight broke out at the Newnan High School and East Coweta High School game.

news.title: East Point police credit new crime center for fast response times
news.summary: The East Point Police Department is using a high-tech Real Time Crime Center to cut response times and monitor criminal activity across the city.

news.title: Family heartbroken after music producer, DJ killed in attempted robbery
news.summary: Atlanta Police are searching for a gunman after a 33-year-old music producer was shot and killed during an attempted robbery last Friday in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Loganville man sentenced for 2021 sexual assault of teen, DA says
news.summary: A Loganville man was sentenced to life in prison plus 30 years after being found guilty of sexually assaulting a teenager in 2021, the Gwinnett County District Attorney’s Office said.

news.title: Police in Athens now say there's 'no evidence' for downtown sexual assault, but two accused of taking and using student's debit card
news.summary: The victim, a 20-year-old UGA student, told police she had been drinking with friends at downtown bars Thursday night before she lost her memory of what happened.

news.title: Driver jailed after brief chase leads to major DeKalb County drug bust
news.summary: Officers seized two kilograms of fentanyl-laced cocaine during a DeKalb County drug bust near Browns Mill Road and Klondike Road.

news.title: 25+ years in prison for two men in Gwinnett County gang hit orchestrated by Minnesota 'Somalian Outlawz' group, DA says
news.summary: The Gwinnett County DA's Office said Friday that the two men pleaded guilty in a January 2022 shooting that killed one man and seriously injured another.
